analogy.rationale: Nicotine metabolites (e.g., cotinine) have no annotated targets and act primarily on nicotinic acetylcholine receptors, which are barely expressed in these cell lines, so they should produce little to no transcriptional response. Other cholinergic agents are listed only as weak analogs because they also engage acetylcholine signaling, but they too are unlikely to elicit a strong response in these cells.
